core_categories: Medical Gases; Respiratory & Sleep Therapy Devices; Clinical Equipment; Home Respiratory Care; Handling & Storage Equipment
specialty_focus: BOC Healthcare is a manufacturer and distributor of medical-grade gases, clinical devices, and home respiratory care solutions. It supplies hospitals, aged care facilities, general practitioners, dentists, and veterinarians, with a focus on home and clinical oxygen services, pain management via analgesic systems, and regulatory-compliant medical supply chains. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
